tasks.label: Load World Cup data
args:
set -e
if ! psql --username=freecodecamp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --quiet --command="SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='worldcup'" | grep -q 1; then
  psql --username=freecodecamp --dbname=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --command="CREATE DATABASE worldcup"
fi
psql --username=freecodecamp --dbname=worldcup --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  team_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games (
  game_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  year INT NOT NULL,
  round VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  winner_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(team_id),
  opponent_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(team_id),
  winner_goals INT NOT NULL,
  opponent_goals INT NOT NULL
);
SQL
bash insert_data.sh
psql --username=freecodecamp --dbname=worldcup --tuples-only --no-align --command="SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams) AS teams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games) AS games;"
